study_period_definition.exclusion_rule: FAILDATE < 1984-03-31 excluded from study-period event lookup; RESTYPE normalized via strip().upper() into FAILURE vs ASSISTANCE
study_period_definition.note: No upper date filter is applied when counting study-period transaction rows or conflicting FAILURE dates in make_events, though eventual_outcome applies as_of = 2026-06-30.

grouping_and_counting_rules.group_key: CERT (normalized to int64 after excluding pre-study rows)

full_history_comparison_1934_to_2026.scope: All rows in failures.parquet with non-missing CERT (n = 3,629 rows across 3,585 distinct CERTs; excludes 488 pre-study missing-CERT rows)
full_history_comparison_1934_to_2026.explanation_of_discrepancy: The report's 44 / 37 / 4 / 3 breakdown was computed across all 3,629 non-null CERT rows in the full historical failures table (1934-2026), rather than restricting to Part 2's study period (FAILDATE >= 1984-03-31). Under Part 2's study-period cutoff, 9 multi-event CERTs drop out of the multi-date set (6 assistance+failure CERTs and 3 assistance-only CERTs have pre-1984-03-31 events), leaving 35 study-period multi-event-date CERTs (31 assistance+failure, 1 assistance-only, 3 conflicting failure dates). Changing the study start to 1984-01-01 or capping at 2026-06-30 leaves the study-period breakdown unchanged at 35 (31 / 1 / 3).

reconciliation_with_part2_summary.study_period_assistance_rows_reconciliat: 378 (single-date assistance-only) + 31 (assistance+failure) + 2 (1 assistance-only multi-date x 2 rows) = 411 == study_period_assistance_rows
reconciliation_with_part2_summary.study_period_failure_rows_reconciliation: 2842 (confirmed_failure_certs x 1 row) + 6 (3 ambiguous_failure_certs x 2 rows) = 2848 == study_period_failure_rows

44_distinct_certs_with_multiple_event_da.reason: Report value 44 reflects full 1934-2026 non-null CERT history, not Part 2's study period (>= 1984-03-31), which has 35.

37_certs_with_both_assistance_and_failur.reason: Study-period count is 31; 37 includes 6 CERTs with pre-1984-03-31 events.

4_certs_with_only_assistance_events_and_.reason: Study-period count is 1 (with 2 ASSISTANCE records); 4 includes 3 CERTs with pre-1984-03-31 events (all 4 in full history have 2 ASSISTANCE records each).

3_certs_with_conflicting_failure_dates.reason: Matches both Part 2 study-period count (ambiguous_failure_cert_count: 3) and full history; all 3 have 2 FAILURE rows on 2 distinct dates and 0 ASSISTANCE rows.
